newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy plans BNL privatisation post merger.
newsitem.headline: Italy plans BNL privatisation post merger.

text.p: Italian Treausry Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Wednesday that the government intended to privatise Banca Nazionale del Lavoro once it had been merged with Banco di Napoli.
"It is (the government's) intention to proceed with the privatisation of BNL after the fusion with Banco di Napoli," Ciampi told a meeting of the Italian banking association (ABI).

BNL recently linked up with insurer INA to take a 60 percent stake in loss making Banco di Napoli as part of a rescue plan for the troubled southern Italian bank. The acquisition is due to be completed before the end of the summer.
Banco di Napoli clocked up a cumulative 5.797 trillion lire of losses between 1994 and 1996. The Treasury still owns 39 percent of Banco di Napli and also owns BNL.
